messages:
Avery: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands. Starting a live Q&A thread for product roadmap clarifications (API streaming, Console metrics, Optimize recommendations). Keep questions short and we'll follow up.

Priya: Quick summary up front: streaming alpha (low_latency mode) targeted ~4 weeks from today; Console per-model metrics beta aimed for late June; Optimize quant advisor early preview planned for August. I'll publish a short timeline doc after this thread.

Ravi: For Dedicated customers: will opt-in require any config changes to pool sizing or instance types?

Marco: Short answer: maybe. The low_latency path benefits from a slightly larger KV cache and different scheduling. We'll surface a "recommended pool size" in Console when you toggle the mode; no forced migration.

Elena: How will we measure regressions for quantization suggestions? need a safety net.

Marco: Optimize will run candidate quantized variants against a customer-supplied prompt set and our default eval corpus. We calculate an expected quality delta + confidence interval and block suggestions that fail regression thresholds.

Jordan: Will Console beta show per-model cost broken down by route (chat vs embeddings)?

Priya: Yes 1 per-model cost breakdown will include generation vs embedding token splits, per-route usage, and projected monthly spend. Beta will also include CSV export for finance.

Sam: SDK note: we'll add streaming helpers (backpressure + reconnect) and a new header X-Redwood-Stream for backward compatibility in SDK 1.6. Docs + migration guide will ship with the release.

Avery: Can we include a short curl snippet for the announcement?

Sam: Example (announcement copy):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","streaming_mode":"low_latency","input":"Draft a short product update."}'
```

Ravi: Anyone owning customer comms for the beta opt-in? we need an FAQ + opt-in flow in Console.

Jordan: I'll own comms with CS and Sales. Draft email + FAQ by next Wed.

DevTools-Bot: Roadmap stub published: https://go.redwood/roadmap-q2q3; runbook template created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/streaming-alpha-template (owner: Marco)

Elena: Telemetry question 1 how long will per-model traces be retained during beta?

Priya: Retain detailed per-model traces for 90 days during beta, aggregated metrics for 12 months. We'll include retention and storage estimates in the timeline doc.

Marco: I'll create the canary checklist and a rollback playbook by EOD Friday.

Avery: Recap: Priya posts timeline doc, Marco posts runbook & canary checklist, Sam opens SDK PR + docs, Jordan drafts comms + FAQ, Ravi will coordinate Dedicated testing. Please add a one-line reply here when you start your task. Closing thread for new questions; will convert into a follow-up note. :wave:
